extension.description: Collecte legere en tache de fond : metriques systeme (charge, memoire, temperature, throttling), erreurs du journal Kodi et detection de stalls, dans des fichiers JSONL bornes consultables via la commande analyser-de-performances.

Lightweight background collector: system metrics (load, memory, temperature, throttling), Kodi log errors and stall detection, into bounded JSONL files readable via the analyser-de-performances command.
